reason: r23 approved for distribution: coloured badges on quest counter rows for key quests and urgent quests, orange for quests that grant Hunter Arts or Felyne ingredients and the quests their unlock chains require, and blue for quests that unlock others.
runtime_test: r23 loaded on Eden and on MHGURecomp beside WishFinder r143 with the candidate NRO; the user reports it working after many runs, unitemized.

ai_code.scope: Implementing Rust native callbacks, runtime GUI insertion and cleanup, progression classification, colour settings and checked configuration persistence, tests and standalone build/package tooling. Claude Code: the quest unlock and reward research, the build-time quest lists, the blue and orange badges and their colour settings.

limitations: r23 ran on Eden and MHGURecomp on the user's report, unitemized; Ryujinx and Switch hardware have no run
The orange and blue badges follow the base 1.4.0 unlock rules and rewards; quests another mod adds get none, and changed unlock rules are not followed
Loading beside a real second row-child mod has only run in the ARM fixture
The tester's updated Forge loader revision and physical Switch compatibility have not been verified.

evidence.static_summary: r23: pinned toolchain build; 18 core tests, the quest-list test (557 unlock and 80 reward IDs, hand-traced cases), the ARM suite and 46 native adapter cases passed, including blue on quest 220, orange over blue on quest 233 and their completion; verify passed.
evidence.manual_summary: r23 on Eden and MHGURecomp, beside WishFinder r143: "its working well", after many runs, unitemized. r21 on MHGU Recomp 0.18.3: "it run perfectly in recomp now and it marks chained quests". r20 reported working on Eden; see EVIDENCE.json.
